# JMeter Plugin Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > QA > JMeter

## Overview

Extends JMeter with plugins for advanced protocols, custom samplers, and enhanced reporting capabilities

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [jmeter-plugin-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
jmeter-plugin-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@jmeter-plugin-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Install and configure JMeter plugins
- Use Custom Thread Groups for complex patterns
- Implement WebSocket and gRPC testing
- Add Throughput Shaping Timer for load profiles

## Technology Standards Applied

- **JMeter Plugins**: Plugin manager and popular plugins
- **Custom Thread Groups**: Advanced load pattern configuration
- **Backend Listener**: Real-time monitoring integration
